specs_json.delivery_mechanism: tethered autonomous 'droid' lowered from ~300 ft hover

notes: Platform 2 (P2 Zip) hybrid VTOL for precision home delivery; hovers high and winches a maneuverable droid to drop packages within ~a dinner-plate radius. FAA Part 135 operations; BVLOS approvals expanding since 2023.

failure_modes.name: Tether/winch jam during droid deployment
failure_modes.mitigation: tether inspection/replacement schedule, winch load-cell monitoring, auto-retract and return-to-nest on anomaly

failure_modes.name: Droid thruster failure causing drop-point inaccuracy
failure_modes.mitigation: pre-flight droid self-test, wind limits enforcement, redundant thruster control

failure_modes.name: Transition failure between hover and cruise
failure_modes.mitigation: redundant lift motors, transition envelope monitoring, parachute/safe-landing contingency logic

failure_modes.name: Acoustic/visual DAA false alarms in bird-dense corridors
failure_modes.mitigation: corridor tuning of DAA thresholds, route planning away from rookeries, fleet-level data feedback

failure_modes.name: Battery reserve shortfall on max-range missions with headwind
failure_modes.mitigation: conservative energy margins in mission planner, live wind-aloft integration, alternate landing sites

failure_modes.name: Icing/precipitation exposure beyond ops limits
failure_modes.mitigation: weather-hold dispatch rules, onboard weather monitoring, geofenced no-go weather cells
